dct_description_sm: Our long-term goal is to evaluate the subtle behavioural effects of the low-to-moderate pre and postnatal exposure to environmental contaminants, to dissociate the effects of each group of contaminants all along the children development, from 1 to 10 years of age, by using accurate innovative methods of behavioural assessments. The assessment of behavioural effects of environmental contaminants with behavioural coding of video recordings involved 3 distinct steps: (a) collection of video recordings in Nunavik, (b) behavioural analysis of these video recordings in the lab (behavioural coding), (c) statistical analysis of data obtained from behavioural coding.
